outingLog.line: Stan falls in beside you. "Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. Let us go find the green."

statusAfter.label: Set out together to forage
statusAfter.reason: Walk out together and work the green ground. One real forage press, split about half and half, both shares carried home to the pantry.

outingLog.line: Stan holds up their share. "Look at that — 3× Muscadine Grapes for me, 2× Muscadine Grapes for you. Same patch, both packs. (270 kcal theirs, 180 kcal yours.)"
"Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. That was the deal, and it is working."
You unload both shares: 180 kcal from you, 270 kcal from Stan — 450 kcal into the pantry. You both made the trip and brought the food home.
